def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    cities = list(d["cities"])
    cost = d["cost"]
    capacity = d["capacity"]
    demand = d["demand"]

    # ordered list of arcs (i, j) that have a defined route
    arcs = [(i, j) for i in cities for j in cost[i]]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.I = pyo.Set(initialize=cities, ordered=True)
    model.ARCS = pyo.Set(initialize=arcs, dimen=2, ordered=True)

    def cap_bound(m, i, j):
        return (0, capacity[i][j])

    model.x = pyo.Var(
        model.ARCS,
        domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
        bounds=cap_bound,
    )

    # Objective: minimize total transportation cost
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(cost[i][j] * m.x[i, j] for (i, j) in m.ARCS)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # Constraint 1: flow balance for each city
    #   inflow - outflow = demand
    def balance_rule(m, i):
        inflow = sum(m.x[j, i] for j in cities if (j, i) in arcs)
        outflow = sum(m.x[i, j] for j in cities if (i, j) in arcs)
        return inflow - outflow == demand[i]

    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.I, rule=balance_rule)

    # Constraint 2: capacity limits (upper bound already set on var, but
    # stated explicitly as a constraint for clarity)
    def capacity_rule(m, i, j):
        return m.x[i, j] <= capacity[i][j]

    model.capacity = pyo.Constraint(model.ARCS, rule=capacity_rule)

    return model

        )
        inflow = sum(

    model.capacity = pyo.Constraint(model.ARCS, rule=capacity_rule)

    return model

        return d["ARCS"][(i, j)][0]

    def _cap(m, i, j):
        return d["ARCS"][(i, j)][1]

    model.cost = pyo.Param(model.ARCS, initialize=_cost)
    model.cap = pyo.Param(model.ARCS, initialize=_cap)

    def _x_bounds(m, i, j):
        return (0, d["ARCS"][(i, j)][1])

    model.x = pyo.Var(model.ARCS, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
                      bounds=_x_bounds)

    def _obj(m):
        return sum(m.cost[i, j] * m.x[i, j] for (i, j) in m.ARCS)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=_obj, sense=pyo.minimize)

    def _balance_rule(m, k):
        inflow = sum(m.x[i, j] for (i, j) in m.ARCS if j == k)
        outflow = sum(m.x[i, j] for (i, j) in m.ARCS if i == k)
        return inflow - outflow == d["DEMAND"][k]

    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.CITIES, rule=_balance_rule)

    def _cap_rule(m, i, j):
        return m.x[i, j] <= m.cap[i, j]

    model.capacity = pyo.Constraint(model.ARCS, rule=_cap_rule)

    return model


if __name__ == "__main__":
    m = build_model()
    print("Build succeeded. Model ready for a solver.")
